content: Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ kanetiniunieritɨani: Tupiriya kanitineikakaitɨni 'ari ti'aitame hetsiemieme tiuka'itsanatɨku, hikɨ Ti'aitame nekaniuxeiya 'utsikari wakuha'aritɨwame.

Kepaukari 'utsikari tupiriya kwiepa memukaxɨkai mɨpaɨ nekatiniuhiwa: ―Yawé nekakaɨyari, waɨkawa nepɨmatsiwawirie ketiniwareuyehɨwiri Kakuwu nuiwarimama. Pɨkayɨwe xɨari memukuwikweni, 'etsimekaniyupaɨmeni.
Hikɨ Yawé kaniwarutinenimayata, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Matsi mɨpaɨ pɨkatiyɨni.

Meta Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ kanetiniunieritɨani: Mana Yawé kaniuwekaitɨni, mɨpaɨ haitɨ kename 'aixɨa tiyurienikekai taikɨ, mɨkɨ haramara meukatewatsie naime pɨtaxɨxɨtsitɨwakai metatsiere kwiepa mu'ɨtsiyatsie.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ nekatiniuhiwa: ―Yawé nekakaɨyari, waɨkawa nepɨmatsiwawirie, mɨpaɨ pepɨkatiyurieneni. Xɨari mepɨkakuwikweni Kakuwu nuiwarimama, 'etsimepuyupaɨme.
Hikɨ Yawé kaniwarutinenimayata, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―'Ikɨ mɨpaɨta pɨkatiyɨni.
Yawé tawarita kanetiniuxeitsitɨani: Mɨkɨ 'akaniuwekaitɨni kuraru 'amatayewa 'aurie, mɨkɨ kii 'inɨnɨatame mahete pahanakai.

Yawé mɨpaɨ kanetiniuta'iwawiya: ―¿'Amuxi, tita petixeiya? Mɨpaɨ nekatinita'eiya: ―Kii 'inɨnɨatame mahete pepahana. Hikɨ Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Keneuxeiya, 'ikɨ kii 'inɨnɨatame mahete neteɨterima 'ixaheritsixi wahixɨapa nekaneikahɨamɨkɨ, 'ari tawariri nepɨkatiwareuyehɨwirieni.

Hikɨ 'Amatsiyaxi, mawari wewiwame Weteri kiekame, Keruwuhani niuki kanenɨ'airieni 'Ixaheritsie ti'aitame: «'Amuxi 'axakametinikuxatani 'ixaheritsixi yunaime wahɨxie. 'Ari 'ena kiekatari mepɨwaɨripie me'i'enietɨ,
Hikɨ 'Amatsiyaxi mɨpaɨ 'Amuxi katiniutahɨawe: ―Keneumieni 'ekɨ pemɨniere, mɨpaɨ petikuxatatɨ xɨka pereu'iwamɨkɨni, kenemie Kura kwieyaritsie.
Tawariri Weteri pepɨkarehekɨatani, 'ena ti'aitame tukieya manuwe kanihɨkɨtɨni, meta 'ikɨ kwieyaritsie tuki manuwe.
'Amuxi mɨpaɨ 'Amatsiyaxi katiniuta'eiya: ―Ne Kakaɨyari niukameya nepɨkahɨkɨ meta Kakaɨyari niukameya nu'aya nepɨkahɨkɨ, matsi ne muxatsi nepɨwahɨweme meta piní nekaniuka'etsani.
Peru Yawé muxatsi watsata kanenayewitɨni, mɨpaɨ kanetiniutahɨawe: “Kenemie neniukame pepayani ketiniwarutaxatɨa 'ixaheritsixi neteɨterima”.
